Requires BepInEx.

UPDATE 2026-10-02: Recompiled due to game changes. `void ShipSitu.ResetAccelerations()` -> `void ShipSitu.ResetAccelerations(bool bInternalOnly = true)`

Adds 4 tiers of tank stations that empty specific tanks to refill your ship's tanks. Tier 1 is 1x1 and accepts a single can. Tier 2 is 3x3 and accepts 9 cans, or 1 large tank. Tier 3 adds the behavior of draining from a docked derelict. Tier 4 adds remote draining from a selected ship.The supply kiosk has T1 stations and a 30% chance of a T2 station. You can also find these on derelicts.
T3 only spawns on hauler ships. Moor to one and "borrow" it.
T4 is rare loot on a Ceres pirate ship.

Flow rates and spawn chances of different tiers are configurable.

This mod should be safe to install to an existing save. Bad things might happen if you uninstall from a save though. It adds conditions to ships to keep track of drained fuel.

Kiosk insertion and derelict spawning logic based on code by Valtora.
Nav map label based on code by EddieSM.
Almost all of the code was written by Kimi K3.

Source at https://github.com/SpencerLeung1024/TankStations, MIT license.
